segments.name: Uranium
segments.description: Conventional and ISR uranium extraction, recovery and sales, plus recycling of uranium-bearing materials and evaluation of U.S. uranium properties.
segments.evidence: The uranium segment engages in conventional and ISR uranium extraction, recovery and sales of uranium from mineral properties and the recycling of uranium-bearing materials generated by third parties (Alternate Feed Materials) along with the exploration, permitting and evaluation of uranium properties in the U.S.

segments.name: REE
segments.description: Developing full rare earth separation capability at the Mill to produce light and heavy separated rare earth oxides from monazite and other feedstocks.
segments.evidence: The REE segment is engaged in the Company's initiatives to progress towards full REE separation capabilities at the Mill to produce both "light" and "heavy" separated REE oxides.

segments.name: HMS
segments.description: Explores, develops and recovers heavy mineral sands at the Kwale, Vara Mada and Bahia projects and the Donald Project JV for titanium and zirconium production.
segments.evidence: The HMS segment engages in the exploration and development, and planned recovery, of HMS at the Vara Mada Project, Bahia Project and through the Company's investment in the Donald Project JV.

revenueModel.text: The company sells uranium concentrate to nuclear utilities under long-term contracts and on the spot market, sells heavy mineral sands to third parties upon shipment, and earns fees from processing Alternate Feed Materials for others.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company generates uranium revenues from extracting and processing materials for the recovery of uranium (and vanadium) for our own account, as well as from purchasing and toll processing materials for others.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company acquired Base Resources, adding the Vara Mada (formerly Toliara) and Kwale projects.
changes.evidence: the Vara Mada Project acquired through the Company's 100% acquisition of Base Resources on October 2, 2024

changes.text: In 2024 the Company formed the Donald Project JV with Astron to jointly develop and operate the Donald Project.
changes.evidence: the Donald Project through the Company's Donald Project JV, which was created on June 3, 2024 when the Company executed JV Agreements with Astron to jointly develop and operate the Donald Project JV

changes.text: The Kwale Project ceased mining operations at the end of 2024 and is now in reclamation, with the final HMS product shipped in April 2025.
changes.evidence: The HMS segment also includes the Kwale Project, which ceased mine operations on December 31, 2024 and is now in reclamation.
